name: project-guardian
description: A reliable local project-memory guardian with integrity checks, repair workflows, MCP tools, handover, and evidence-based knowledge lookup.

interface.shortDescription: Keep durable project memory for AI-assisted coding teams.
interface.longDescription: Project Guardian creates, validates, repairs, and queries durable project memory. It provides structured change and decision records, budget-aware reading plans, evidence locations, guarded CLI and MCP tools, review workflows, handover guides, and local audit trails without requiring a database or hosted AI service.
